nodes.assumption: Existing artifact.py code has an established pattern for refusing writes (exception type or function name Refused, error message format) and the keys_from validation logic can determine when to exempt names starting '_' by checking whether the jurisdiction pattern would match them.
nodes.would_settle: Specify the refusal mechanism (exception type Refused, message format naming extra keys and pointing at the jurisdiction path) and clarify with an example how to implement the '_' exemption: when building keys_from validation, skip validation for top-level keys starting with '_' if the pattern matches names like '_charter+why.json'.
